visualLanguage: design_system/public/PUBLIC_UI.md. The KB-era index.html that used to sit in this directory was DELETED 2026-08-27: it was retired as a visual target on 2026-08-26 and kept only because ci:mockup-coverage required a parity.json beside any index.html, which is a gate keeping a dead file alive. The target is the patterns in PUBLIC_UI.md, built from components/site/v3. THIS FILE STILL BINDS: requiredComponents is what stops a page silently losing a section, and ci:mockup-parity reads it with or without a mockup.
competitiveTarget: Beat generic national-brokerage profile pages by opening on the firm, then client reviews as the primary proof, then local closings, then a four-up reach, then a short who-you-work-with teaser to /team, then inquiry to /contact. No national pitch. No full broker roster on About.
note: Looking brief 2026-09-12. Order is Breadcrumb, AboutFirmHero #firm, V3Proof #proof (reviews primary, score face + words), FirmClosings #firm-sales, V3Doors #reach (four-up CTA), AboutTeamTeaser #who-you-work-with → /team, V3Quiet #inquiry → /contact, V3Atlas, Quiet #about, V3Answers, Footer. No AboutFaces. No three equal broker Cards. No per-broker Call buttons.

requiredComponents.name: MetadataBlock
requiredComponents.section: AboutPage + aboutOrganization + BreadcrumbList + FAQPage JSON-LD. V3Quiet and V3Instrument carry no structured data of their own.

requiredComponents.name: V3Breadcrumb
requiredComponents.section: Chrome. Home > About. Surface tone (this page opens on cream, not a dark Stage). Current page never a link.

requiredComponents.name: AboutFirmHero
requiredComponents.section: OPENS THE PAGE. H1 About Ryan Realty · Bend, firm beat (since 2014, Bend office, who you call works your deal), Street View exterior of 115 NW Oregon Ave #2. Never the interior sofa. Never AboutFaces.

requiredComponents.name: V3Quiet
requiredComponents.section: Twice: #inquiry (Write the office → /contact) and #about (origin plus the firm and principal-broker licences as sourced facts, never a KPI Instrument).

requiredComponents.name: FirmClosings
requiredComponents.section: Recent Ryan Realty closings as V3Carousel / shadcn carousel AFTER reviews (Card slides: photo, address, recorded ClosePrice, beds/baths/sqft, listing door). Child of the page so about/page.tsx never mounts a city-stats Ledger.

requiredComponents.name: V3Answers
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 8, closing. The same ABOUT_FAQ_ITEMS array the FAQPage JSON-LD emits, as native disclosures.

requiredComponents.name: V3Atlas
requiredComponents.section: The service area as the living map: every town, community, and Bend neighborhood with a recorded boundary as a door.

requiredComponents.name: V3Proof
requiredComponents.section: PRIMARY PROOF after the firm hero. Score face plus the newest verified Google reviews as words, headingLevel 2, a door to /reviews. Same DAL read (getReviews).

requiredComponents.name: V3Footer
requiredComponents.section: Chrome. V3_FOOTER_COLUMNS. Rendered OUTSIDE <main> so the footer maps to role=contentinfo.

requiredComponents.name: V3Doors
requiredComponents.section: #reach, the four-up CTA. `primary` on the call door with the V3OnDuty live state; text, email and Schedule as the lighter alternatives.

requiredComponents.name: V3OnDuty
requiredComponents.section: The live state on the reach control: published booking hours against the Pacific clock. NEVER a reply-time figure.

requiredComponents.name: AboutTeamTeaser
requiredComponents.section: Who you work with. Photo + name only, one door to /team. No licenses, no Call buttons, no deep bios, no AboutFaces roster.

layoutComponents.name: PublicNav
layoutComponents.note: Resolves to V3Chrome today. The KbNav entry above is the one the gate auto-satisfies.

deferredComponents.name: V3Sheet
deferredComponents.reason: About destinations open on Quiet + Sheet, but the capture forms already live on /contact and /team/[slug]. Adding a Sheet here would be a new capture contract.

deferredComponents.name: V3Stage
deferredComponents.reason: Pattern 4 needs owned media and is never allowed over a number. The firm hero is the office photograph on cream, not a navy-scrim Stage.

deferredComponents.name: V3Field
deferredComponents.reason: Pattern 2 is live inventory as a spatial surface. It opens Homes. Using it here would compete with /homes-for-sale.

deferredComponents.name: V3Instrument
deferredComponents.reason: Licenses are one sourced Quiet line (firm + PB), not a KPI hero.
